en_title: Blade Runner 2099 Executive Producers Confirm Franchise Owners Are In Talks for "AAA" Video Game Adaptation
cn_title: 《银翼杀手2099》执行制片人确认系列版权方正在洽谈「AAA」级游戏改编
opus_summary: 《银翼杀手2099》执行制片人、Alcon Entertainment联合首席执行官Andrew Kosove和Broderick Johnson确认，公司正洽谈制作一款《银翼杀手》3A级游戏。Kosove强调了玩家与《银翼杀手》世界互动的重要性，但没有透露更多细节。

paragraphs.en: Andrew Kosove and Broderick Johnson, executive producers for Blade Runner 2099 and co-CEOs of Alcon Entertainment, the owner of the Blade Runner franchise, have confirmed that they are in discussions to create a AAA video game based on the iconic cyberpunk IP.
paragraphs.cn: 《银翼杀手2099》执行制片人、拥有《银翼杀手》系列版权的Alcon Entertainment联合首席执行官Andrew Kosove和Broderick Johnson确认，他们正在商谈根据这一标志性赛博朋克IP制作一款AAA级电子游戏。

paragraphs.en: I got the chance to chat with Kosove and Johnson ahead of Blade Runner 2099’s release on Prime Video later this month. During our conversation, I brought up the wildly successful Cyberpunk 2077 , wondering why Blade Runner hasn’t had a similar AAA game made after it, and if any conversations have been had about finally giving this IP a major modern video game release.
paragraphs.cn: 在《银翼杀手2099》于本月晚些时候登陆Prime Video之前，我有机会与Kosove和Johnson聊了聊。交谈中，我提到了大获成功的《赛博朋克2077》，想知道为什么《银翼杀手》没有被改编成类似的AAA级游戏，以及他们是否曾讨论过最终为这一IP推出一款大型现代电子游戏。

paragraphs.en: “Yes,” Kosove confirmed, and emphasized the phrase “AAA,” making it clear that Alcon has a grand vision for Blade Runner’s future in the gaming space. Of course, he couldn’t tell me much more, but impressed upon the importance of allowing players to “interact” with the world of Blade Runner in this hypothetical game.
paragraphs.cn: 「是的。」Kosove确认道，并强调了「AAA」这个词，明确表示Alcon对《银翼杀手》在游戏领域的未来有着宏大的愿景。当然，他无法向我透露更多信息，但他强调了让玩家在这款设想中的游戏里与《银翼杀手》的世界「互动」的重要性。

paragraphs.en: This is big news for Blade Runner fans and fans of the cyberpunk genre, in general; while Blade Runner has enjoyed its status as a cult-classic and cornerstone of modern science fiction, it hasn’t exactly been blessed in the game department.
paragraphs.cn: 对于《银翼杀手》粉丝和整个赛博朋克题材的爱好者来说，这是个重大消息；尽管《银翼杀手》作为一部邪典经典和现代科幻作品的基石享有盛誉，但它在游戏方面的境遇并不算好。

paragraphs.en: Based on IGN’s own list of Blade Runner games , the franchise has four licensed titles; the first, published in 1985 by CRL Group PLC for the Commodore 64, is an absolute dinosaur of a game that wasn’t well-received even at the time of its release. In the game, players hunt down replicants (here, ‘replidroids’) for bounty money. Due to the cost of movie rights at the time, this game was said to merely be “inspired” by the ‘Vangelis soundtrack’ of Ridley Scott’s 1982 film and not a direct adaptation.
paragraphs.cn: 根据IGN自己的《银翼杀手》游戏列表，该系列共有四款获授权作品；第一款由CRL Group PLC于1985年在Commodore 64上发行，是一款不折不扣的老古董，即使在发行当时也没有获得好评。在游戏中，玩家追捕复制人（这里称为「replidroids」）以赚取赏金。由于当时电影版权的费用，这款游戏据称只是「受到」雷德利·斯科特1982年电影的「Vangelis配乐」启发，而非直接改编。

paragraphs.en: The next Blade Runner game, which was released in 1997, enjoyed far more critical acclaim and is still considered a classic to this day. Developed by Westwood Studios and published by Virgin Interactive, this point-and-click adventure title was one of the very first titles to use 3D character models and real-time environments. A remake was released in 2022.
paragraphs.cn: 下一款《银翼杀手》游戏于1997年发行，获得了多得多的好评，至今仍被视为经典。这款点击式冒险游戏由Westwood Studios开发、Virgin Interactive发行，是最早使用3D角色模型和实时环境的游戏之一。其重制版于2022年发行。

paragraphs.en: Another game, titled Blade Runner 2033: Labyrinth, was announced in 2023 and developed by Annapurna Interactive; unfortunately, the project is now largely considered to be canceled, having been delisted from Steam and removed from Annapurna’s website. (Blade Runner 2049: Replicant Pursuit was released in 2017. It was a short, tie-in VR experience meant to promote the second film, but not a full, official game.)
paragraphs.cn: 另一款名为《Blade Runner 2033: Labyrinth》的游戏于2023年公布，由Annapurna Interactive开发；遗憾的是，该项目如今被普遍认为已经取消，因为它已从Steam下架，并从Annapurna的网站上移除。（《Blade Runner 2049: Replicant Pursuit》于2017年发行。它是一款旨在宣传第二部电影的简短联动VR体验，而非完整的官方游戏。）

paragraphs.en: Given that it’s been nearly 30 years since Blade Runner fans have had a fresh, critically-acclaimed video game adaptation, this latest news is extremely exciting and opens up an entire world of possibilities. And considering Kosove’s focus on player interactivity and AAA quality, it sounds like Alcon has a clear vision for what it wants this game to be — and I can’t wait to see what they come up with.
paragraphs.cn: 鉴于《银翼杀手》粉丝已有近30年没有玩到一款全新且广受好评的改编电子游戏，这一最新消息令人无比兴奋，也开启了一个充满可能性的广阔世界。考虑到Kosove对玩家互动性和AAA级品质的重视，听起来Alcon对于希望将这款游戏做成什么样有着清晰的愿景——我迫不及待想看看他们会带来什么。

paragraphs.en: Blade Runner 2099 releases on Prime Video on November 25.
paragraphs.cn: 《银翼杀手2099》将于11月25日在Prime Video上线。
